purpose: The MVP line's first scenario (planning/mvp-m0-plan.md, Scenarios and the harness, Q9): B7's two Linux guests re-hosted on two domain harts under static ownership, with hart 0 as the control hart. It names the binding, the rings, the run limits, the guest programs, and the expected outcomes of the scenario, its negative variants, and its probe images.
trust: Data only. tools/gen-scenario.py checks it against src/mvp-layout.h and tools/gen-dts.py and emits the build header and the checkers' expectation files from it; a change is a rebuild, never a run-time selection.
scope: M0. Hart IDs, domain indices, and VMIDs are identifiers, not authority (S1 H03).
name: two-guests

domains.name: G0
domains.bootargs: earlycon=sbi console=hvc0 panic=-1 oops=panic panic_on_warn=1 -- be.guest=0

domains.name: G1
domains.bootargs: earlycon=sbi console=hvc0 panic=-1 oops=panic panic_on_warn=1 -- be.guest=1

domain_lines: [<s>] Kernel command line: earlycon=sbi console=hvc0 panic=-1 oops=panic panic_on_warn=1 -- be.guest=<g>
[<s>] riscv-timer: Timer interrupt in S-mode is available via sstc extension
rejected: extension is not available in SBI

variants.name: payload
variants.change: the kernel's magic2 RSC\x05 becomes RSC\x00

variants.name: ring-full
variants.change: each outbound ring is 1 KiB, and hart 0 waits 0x2000000 ticks after both domains' ENTERED before its first LINE drain (Plan revision M0-A.3)

variants.name: no-sstc
variants.change: the accepted R5 QEMU CPU, without Sstc

variants.name: firmware-version
variants.change: the earlier firmware, OpenSBI v1.6 as pinned by MVP_PIN_OPENSBI_*, reports SBI 2.0

variants.name: shim-rule
variants.change: the shim starts hart 1 at its entry and stops the hart that booted

variants.name: two-guests-shell
variants.change: each domain's DTB has rdinit=/init-shell and the sealed configuration grants each console input (planning/mvp-m7-plan.md, Q4); tests/session-typist.py types sessions/shell.json

variants.name: hostile
variants.change: G0's DTB has rdinit=/init-hostile, which prints every byte value, a look-alike of hart 0's run line and of G1's prefix, a terminal query and a window title, and a 300-byte line (planning/mvp-m7-plan.md, D-4); no domain is granted console input
